visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a yellow ruffled sleeveless top and a white skirt, stands on the deck of a white boat. She is smiling and pointing towards the sky with her right hand while holding a red snack bag in her left. The background consists of a bright blue sea and lush green islands under a clear, sunny sky with high intensity natural lighting. (2) A close-up shot transitions to focus on a person's outstretched arm and hand holding a single thin snack piece. A large white seagull with gray wings swoops down from the upper right, its beak open to snatch the snack from the fingers. The camera tracks the bird's swift movement against the backdrop of the deep ocean and distant green hills. (3) The scene returns to the woman as she interacts joyfully with several seagulls circling the boat. She laughs while holding up snacks, and the birds hover closely, some almost brushing against her. She carries a small light-colored shoulder bag with a white plush charm. The camera follows her joyful movements as she reacts to the birds' proximity. (4) A final slow-motion sequence captures a seagull approaching her hand to take a cracker. The woman's facial expression is a mix of excitement and playful fear as the bird's wings beat near her. Sunlight reflects brilliantly off the water's surface, creating a shimmering effect behind the boat's white metal railings.
